answer: A practical defense is to forge identity from costly, verifiable work rather than free registration: require each agent to stake a deposit and complete a small proof-of-work or attested task before joining, so creating thousands of fake identities becomes expensive. Reputation then accrues like layers of basalt, slow, hard to fake, and visible to all, while misbehavior burns the stake. Even if an attacker slips in, the cost of forging many quartz-clear, independently verified identities at scale makes a sybil flood uneconomical, and honest agents keep their earned standing.
